---
title: Gerrymandering Metrics
format: typst
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stats)
precinct_2024_general_election <- read.csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

simpler_precinct <- precinct_2024_general_election |>
    select("COUNTY", "TOTVOTE", "CDDIST", "ASSDEM01", "ASSDEM02", "ASSREP01",
    "ASSREP02", "CNGDEM01", "CNGDEM02", "CNGREP01", "CNGREP02",
    "PRSDEM01",  "PRSREP01", "SENDEM01", "SENDEM02",
    "SENREP01", "SENREP02", "USSDEM01", "USSREP01") |>
        filter(
            !if_any(
                .cols = -COUNTY, 
                .fns = ~ . == "***"
                )) |>
                    mutate(
                        across(
                            .cols = -COUNTY, 
                            .fns = ~ as.integer(as.character(.))
                        )
                    )
votes_sr <- read_csv("data/state_g24_sov_data_by_g24_srprec.csv") 
block_corr <- read_csv("data/state_g24_sr_blk_map.csv")
new_district_map <- read_csv("data/ab604.csv")

votes_sr <- votes_sr |>
    select(SRPREC_KEY, CNGDEM01, CNGREP01)
block_corr <- block_corr |>
    select(BLOCK_KEY, SRPREC_KEY, PCTSRPREC)
new_district_map <- read_csv(
    "data/ab604.csv",
    col_names = c("BLOCK_KEY", "NEW_CD"),
  ) |>
  mutate(BLOCK_KEY = as.character(BLOCK_KEY)) |>
  select(BLOCK_KEY, NEW_CD)

allocated_data <- block_corr |>
  left_join(votes_sr, by = "SRPREC_KEY") |>
  mutate(
    CNGDEM01 = as.numeric(CNGDEM01),
    CNGREP01 = as.numeric(CNGREP01),
    
    PCTSRPREC = as.numeric(PCTSRPREC)
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    D_Allocated = CNGDEM01 * (PCTSRPREC / 100), 
    R_Allocated = CNGREP01 * (PCTSRPREC / 100)
  )




final_results_ab604 <- allocated_data |>
  left_join(new_district_map, by = "BLOCK_KEY") |>
  filter(!is.na(NEW_CD)) |>
  group_by(NEW_CD) |>
  
  summarise(
    New_D_Votes = sum(D_Allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    New_R_Votes = sum(R_Allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    New_Total = New_D_Votes + New_R_Votes,
    New_D_Pct = New_D_Votes / New_Total,
    New_Winner = ifelse(New_D_Votes > New_R_Votes, "DEM", "REP")
  )

```


### 2024 Election Results and the 2024 District Map

```{r}

district_data <- simpler_precinct |>
  group_by(CDDIST) |>
  summarise(
    D_Votes = sum(CNGDEM01),
    R_Votes = sum(CNGREP01),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |>

  mutate(
    Two_Party_Total = D_Votes + R_Votes,
    D_Pct = D_Votes / Two_Party_Total
  ) |>
  filter(Two_Party_Total > 0)
print(head(district_data))
```

```{r}
calculate_wasted_votes <- function(party_A_votes, party_B_votes) {
  total_votes <- party_A_votes + party_B_votes
  votes_to_win <- floor(total_votes / 2) + 1
  
  winner <- party_A_votes > party_B_votes
  wasted_A_winner <- party_A_votes - votes_to_win
  wasted_A_loser <- party_A_votes
  wasted_votes_A <- ifelse(winner, wasted_A_winner, wasted_A_loser)
  return(wasted_votes_A)
}
```


```{r}
mean_d_pct <- mean(district_data$D_Pct)
median_d_pct <- median(district_data$D_Pct)
mean_median_score <- (mean_d_pct - median_d_pct) * 100

district_wasted_votes <- district_data |>
  mutate(
    D_Wasted = calculate_wasted_votes(D_Votes, R_Votes),
    R_Wasted = calculate_wasted_votes(R_Votes, D_Votes)
  )

wasted_votes_summary <- district_wasted_votes |>
  summarise(
    Total_D_Wasted = sum(D_Wasted),
    Total_R_Wasted = sum(R_Wasted),
    Total_Statewide_Votes = sum(Two_Party_Total)
  )

TDW <- wasted_votes_summary$Total_D_Wasted
TRW <- wasted_votes_summary$Total_R_Wasted
TVotes <- wasted_votes_summary$Total_Statewide_Votes

efficiency_gap <- ((TRW - TDW) / TVotes) * 100


print("Mean median score")
print(mean_median_score)
print("Efficiency Gap")
print(efficiency_gap)

```

### 2024 Election Results and the proposed 2025 District Map


```{r}
mean_d_pct_new <- mean(final_results_ab604$New_D_Pct, na.rm = TRUE)
median_d_pct_new <- median(final_results_ab604$New_D_Pct, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_median_score_new <- (mean_d_pct_new - median_d_pct_new) * 100


district_wasted_votes_new <- final_results_ab604 |>
  mutate(
    D_Wasted = calculate_wasted_votes(New_D_Votes, New_R_Votes),
    R_Wasted = calculate_wasted_votes(New_R_Votes, New_D_Votes)
  )


wasted_votes_summary_new <- district_wasted_votes_new |>
  summarise(
    Total_D_Wasted = sum(D_Wasted, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_R_Wasted = sum(R_Wasted, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Statewide_Votes = sum(New_Total, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

TDW_new <- wasted_votes_summary_new$Total_D_Wasted
TRW_new <- wasted_votes_summary_new$Total_R_Wasted
TVotes_new <- wasted_votes_summary_new$Total_Statewide_Votes

efficiency_gap_new <- ((TRW_new - TDW_new) / TVotes_new) * 100


print("New Mean median score")
print(mean_median_score_new)
print("New Efficiency Gap")
print(efficiency_gap_new)
```
